args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover note for Marrow Agrisupply. The first two items come from the 9 Jun thread in #central-team, so check for newer status before acting.

- Eastbank door-label mismatch (ticket PD-4821): the receiving-door import attached to the ticket labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. It needs sorting before anyone reimports, or we'll create duplicate doors. Hollis is handling setup/support.

- Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift: the morning receiver says the appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis was going to check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login. No ticket number was given in the thread.

- Pallet-jack icon feature request (FR-882): Marrow asked for custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Per Moss's Central handoffs digest (2 Jan 2026), support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review. I have no later status on it.

Thanks,
Hollis / Pree
